Kit summary

Decayed Staff StrikeBasic
There is a 100% chance to remove 1 attribute buff from all enemies, or there is a 100% chance to remove 1 random buff (prioritizing non-attribute buffs) from all enemies if self Effect RES is not below 100% when casting Decayed Staff Strike. Afterward, deals 120% ATK DMG to all enemies.
Bonsho ShelterActive
Increases all allies' DEF by 60% and Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns. Paulin additionally gains [DMG Immunity] for 1 turn if self Effect RES is not below 100% when casting Bonsho Shelter.
Prompt ActionPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
When an enemy inflicts a Control effect on self and self Effect RES is not below 100%, grants self immunity to the Control effect, and increases self Turn Meter by 20% and other allies' Turn Meters by 10%. Besides, increases self Tenacity by 80% of self initial Effect RES, up to 100%.
Auspicious Dragon Staff Lv.1Increases all allies' Effect RES by 25% at the beginning of each wave for 2 turns if Paulin's initial Effect RES is below 100% but not lower than 50%, or increases all allies' Effect RES by 50% for 2 turns at the beginning of each wave if Paulin's initial Effect RES is not lower than 100%.
Auspicious Dragon Staff Lv.2Paulin increases his Turn Meter by 10% for every enemy target whose SPD is higher than him at the beginning of each wave.
Immense HappinessActiveExclusive Lv.3
Increases all allies' Max HP Cap by 50% for 2 turns and restores their HP by 22% of Paulin's Max HP. Afterward, grants other allies [Stealth] for 2 turns. Paulin cleanses all debuffs from all allies at the beginning of Immense Happiness if self Effect RES is not below 100% when casting Immense Happiness.
Auspicious Dragon Staff Lv.3Gains 1 more turn after casting Immense Happiness, and also grants [Block Debuff] for all allies for 1 turn if Paulin's Effect RES is not lower than 100% when casting Immense Happiness.
Source: game files.
